literal_meaning: আয়ুর্বেদিক ধাতু বা মৌলিক উপাদান (শারীরিক-মানসিক গঠনের মূল উপাদান)
example_sentences_in_english: These things don't suit my temperament.
He has a very stubborn disposition.
history: Derived from the Ayurvedic concept of 'dhatus', the seven fundamental tissues or humors in the body that influence physical and mental constitution, rooted in ancient Indian medical texts like the Charaka Samhita.
note: The term originates from Sanskrit 'dhātu' meaning element or constituent, adapted in Bengali for figurative use in describing innate character.
